note: Pinned downloads only: every url names a fixed commit and is checked against sha256 before use. Optional per font: recommendedMinHeightMm and qualityGrade (GOOD|CAUTION|UNSUITABLE), present for every font, computed from the script sample at 10/20 mm (analysis version 6, docs/lettering.md) by the engine test CatalogQualityTool; the app re-analyzes the font after download. Jua, Noto Sans KR and Gowun Batang are bundled, not listed.
